arrows.name: Arrows
arrows.description: Ammunition for bows. Each shot consumes one arrow.

potion.name: Life Potion
potion.description: A crimson elixir that fully restores your health and cures poison.

speedpotion.name: Potion of Speed
speedpotion.description: A fleeting burst of movement speed lasting 15 turns. A fresh dose refreshes the effect.

strangeGreenPotion.name: Strange Green Potion
strangeGreenPotion.description: A cloudy green elixir of unknown origin. Its effects cannot be identified in advance.

herb.name: Healing Herb
herb.description: A medicinal leaf that restores some health and cures poison when eaten.

mushroom.name: Mushroom
mushroom.description: An unidentified wild mushroom. It may restore health or turn out to be poisonous; the Herbalist can purify it.

ediblemushroom.name: Edible Mushroom
ediblemushroom.description: A mushroom purified by the Herbalist. Safe to eat for a modest health recovery.

berries.name: Handful of Berries
berries.description: Fresh berries that slowly restore health over time.

fish.name: Fresh Fish
fish.description: A freshly caught fish. Eat it as provisions or cook it over a lit fire for better recovery.

shedSkin.name: Shed Skin
shedSkin.description: A preserved reptile skin, useful to traders and collectors.

chitin.name: Chitin
chitin.description: A tough piece of a creature's outer shell.

blightedRoot.name: Blighted Root
blightedRoot.description: An unsettling root from a corrupted creature.

venomGland.name: Venom Gland
venomGland.description: Soaks your equipped weapon, or one arrow in a bow, with a single dose of venom.

spiderSilk.name: Spider Silk
spiderSilk.description: Strong, fine strands collected from a giant spider.

rareTrophy.name: Rare Trophy
rareTrophy.description: An exceptional trophy recovered from a legendary beast.

meat.name: Meat
meat.description: Raw meat taken from a slain beast. Cook it at a lit abandoned campfire before eating.

roastedMeat.name: Roasted Meat
roastedMeat.description: Tender roasted meat that provides gradual health recovery, faster when resting.

bakedPotato.name: Baked Potato
bakedPotato.description: A filling baked potato that restores health gradually, faster while resting.

cookedFish.name: Cooked Fish
cookedFish.description: A nutritious cooked fish that restores health over time, faster during rest.

flint.name: Flint Stone
flint.description: Reusable fire-lighting tool. Use an abandoned campfire to light it with brushwood.

brushwood.name: Brushwood
brushwood.description: Dry fuel for an abandoned campfire. One bundle burns for 12 turns. Carry up to five.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: A raw potato found while foraging or searching. Bake it at a lit campfire or stove.

scrollOfInvisibility.name: Scroll of Invisibility
scrollOfInvisibility.description: A scroll that conceals you from ordinary sight for a limited time. True-sighted enemies may still detect you.

homecomingscroll.name: Scroll of Homecoming
homecomingscroll.description: A magical passage back to the Temple, far from the dangers of the wilderness.

idscroll.name: Scroll of Identification
idscroll.description: Reveals the true name, effects and possible curse of one unidentified artifact.

amber.name: Amber
amber.description: A warm golden piece of fossil resin, prized by traders.

seashell.name: Seashell
seashell.description: A smooth, wave-worn seashell with little use beyond trade.

shovel.name: Shovel
shovel.description: A digging tool for searching sandy ground for buried treasures and surprises.

wheelbarrow.name: Unknown-Alloy Wheelbarrow
wheelbarrow.description: Small wheelbarrow made of an unknown alloy. Surprisingly light and durable.

bigbell.name: Enormous Brass Bell
bigbell.description: An enormous brass bell, impossibly heavy.

blackkey.name: Black Key
blackkey.description: A dark stone key bound to a worn cord, untouched by the passage of time. It feels heavier than it should, as though it remembers something beneath the earth.

echoBlightHorn.name: Echo-Blight Horn
echoBlightHorn.description: A warped hunting horn whose note provokes beasts into answering across great distances.

treasuremap.name: Old Treasure Map
treasuremap.description: A faded map marking the approximate location of something buried. Inspect it for clues.

treasurecasket.name: Old Rotten Casket
treasurecasket.description: An old rotten casket, half-swallowed by the sand.

tombstone.name: Mysterious Tombstone
tombstone.description: An uncanny grave marker with an inscription that may reveal a forgotten history.

oddTombstone.name: Odd Tombstone
oddTombstone.description: An unusual cemetery stone bearing a troubling inscription. The Gravedigger may want to see it.

pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
pickaxe.description: A sturdy iron pickaxe. Strike fractured stone, boulders, and exposed crystals to mine them; subtle seams become easier to notice as Mining improves.

quartz.name: Quartz
quartz.description: A pale crystal mined from stone, suitable for trade.

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.description: A violet crystal pried from the rock, valued by collectors.

topaz.name: Topaz
topaz.description: A golden mineral specimen that catches the light.

aquamarine.name: Aquamarine
aquamarine.description: A clear blue-green gemstone, precious in the markets above.

emerald.name: Emerald
emerald.description: A vivid green gemstone cut free of its dark host rock.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.description: A deep blue gemstone of considerable value.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.description: A rare red gemstone that glows like an ember beneath the light.

dwarvenkey.name: Dwarven Key
dwarvenkey.description: A heavy iron key cut for one of the old locks beneath the Dwarven Fort.

scrollOfFear.name: Scroll of Fear
scrollOfFear.description: Tier 1–3 monsters within 5 tiles flee for 10 turns. Damaging a monster ends its fear; cornered monsters can fight.

scrollOfDeathShield.name: Scroll of Death Shield
scrollOfDeathShield.description: Survive one fatal damage event at 1 HP. No expiry or stacking. Further damage can kill you immediately.

scrollOfChaos.name: Scroll of Chaos
scrollOfChaos.description: Teleports you and monsters within 8 tiles to distinct safe, reachable tiles within 8 tiles of each starting position. Stays on this level.

scrollOfFireball.name: Scroll of Fireball
scrollOfFireball.description: Aim within 6 visible tiles. A 5×5 blast without corners deals 10–50 damage per creature, including you, ignoring armor. Walls block fire. Preview then Cast; Cancel costs nothing.

stoneSkinPotion.name: Potion of Stone Skin
stoneSkinPotion.description: For 15 turns: +6 DEF plus one sixth of DEF (rounded down), −3 GRACE. Repeated doses refresh without stacking.

berserkPotion.name: Potion of Berserk
berserkPotion.description: For 15 turns: +4 ATK plus one sixth of ATK (rounded down), −2 GRACE, −3 DEF. With an adjacent enemy, each action has a 25% chance to become a random melee attack instead. Repeated doses refresh without stacking.

tauntingNote.name: Scrawled Note
tauntingNote.description: A crumpled note with a short message in uneven handwriting.

dwarvenTradeLedger.name: Dwarven Trade Ledger
dwarvenTradeLedger.description: An old merchant ledger sealed with the mark of a dwarven trade guild. The Merchant promised a reward for its return.
